systems.owner: Ministere de la Justice et des Droits Humains, with UNDP support
systems.tiers: An extranet for the public and an intranet for judicial staff, with a database of judicial activity including decisions; N'Djamena jurisdiction is the pilot phase (presented October 2025)

note: A courts-side platform linking litigants and lawyers to the judicial system; the document names no police system and no link to the police, so it gives no fact for station records.
